title: Understand Events Indexes, Metrics Indexes, and Summary Indexes
objectives: Understand Events Indexes, Metrics Indexes, and Summary Indexes
Verify the active operational state and explain the evidence.

tasks.instruction: Create application_events (Events), application_metrics (Metrics), and application_summary (Events) on idx01. Inspect datatype in the catalog or btool.

Explain why a summary destination is an ordinary events index whose contents come from a summary-producing search. Metric index storage is recognized; metric query/rollup behavior is outside this exercise.

hints: Inspect effective configuration and the delivery error before changing a setting.
Creating an index does not add events. Verify the destination, activation and search window independently.
